items.description: Lock the app with Face ID (LocalAuthentication) when it launches and after it has been in the background for 2 minutes. Add an 'App lock' toggle in Profile and the NSFaceIDUsageDescription entry. Show a subtle lock screen with the user's name while authenticating.
items.title: Add Face ID app lock

items.description: A new Insights tab: pick a month, see total spent, a bar chart of spending by category (Groceries, Transport, Food & drink, Subscriptions, etc.) computed from transactions, and the top 5 merchants. Include a simple monthly budget you can set, with a progress bar showing how much is left.

mockups.brief: Spending insights screen in a light, premium banking style matching the app's paper-grey background and emerald-mint accent. Top: inline navigation title 'Insights' with a month stepper '< October >'. Large headline 'Total spent' with a big rounded $2,187.40 figure in ink navy. A horizontal bar chart card (white rounded card, soft shadow) showing category bars with amounts: Groceries, Food & drink, Transport, Subscriptions, Electronics. Below: 'Top merchants' list card with icon circles and amounts, using the app's transaction-row style. At the bottom, a budget card: 'Monthly budget $3,000' with a mint progress bar and '$812 left'. Generous whitespace, rounded 22pt cards, native iOS typography.
mockups.title: Insights

items.title: Add spending insights

items.description: Create named savings goals (e.g. 'Japan trip', 'New laptop') with a target amount and emoji/color, contribute money into a goal from any account (moves the balance like a transfer and records the transaction), and see progress rings on a dedicated Goals screen reachable from Home.

mockups.brief: Savings goals screen, same light paper-grey background, mint accent and white rounded cards as the rest of the app. Navigation title 'Goals' with a '+' button top right. A summary card showing total saved across goals in large rounded navy numerals. Then a vertical list of goal cards: each has a colored progress ring with the percent in the center, goal name (e.g. 'Japan trip'), target '$5,000', saved '$2,150', and a small mint 'Add' button. One card shows a completed goal with a full ring and a 'Goal reached' caption. Bottom of the last card a hint text 'Tap + to start a new goal'. Elegant, airy spacing, native iOS typography.
mockups.title: Savings goals

items.title: Add savings goals

items.description: Schedule recurring bill payments: choose a payee (from contacts or a new bill payee), amount, account, and frequency (weekly/monthly). Show an 'Upcoming payments' list on Home with the next due dates, and automatically record payments when their date arrives while the app is used.
items.title: Add bill payments

items.description: An in-app notification center reachable from the Home header bell: unread badge, and notifications generated for transactions, completed transfers and card freeze events, with an unread/dot state you can clear with 'Mark all read'.
items.title: Add transaction alerts

items.description: Add a search bar to the All activity screen that filters transactions live as you type, matching on merchant name, category, and amount typed (e.g. 'coffee', 'Groceries', '18.40'). Show an empty state with 'No results for "xyz"' when nothing matches, and clear the search automatically when leaving the screen.
items.title: Add activity search

items.description: Round every card transaction up to the next whole dollar and move the difference into a user-chosen savings goal. Add a 'Round up' toggle in Profile with a goal picker, and record a small 'Round up' internal-transfer transaction to the goal for each qualifying purchase, so the goal's progress ring grows with everyday spending.
items.title: Add round up savings

items.description: Let the user issue a virtual single-use card for online shopping from any card account: an 'Add virtual card' button on the Cards tab opens a short flow to pick the source account and spending limit, then shows the new card with its number, expiry, CVC, and freeze controls. Spending against it records transactions on the source account and caps at the limit.
items.title: Add virtual cards

items.description: Add a share/export button on each account detail screen that generates a statement for a chosen month: a CSV file listing that account's transactions for the month with date, merchant, category, and amount, shared via the standard iOS share sheet. Include month navigation so any past month can be exported.
items.title: Add statement export
